19 November 2026

The current situation

New Zealand's economy remains subdued. GDP is expected to be 0.8 per cent in 2026.

Consumer price inflation

Annual inflation is expected to be 2.1 per cent in 2027. Underlying inflation continues to ease.

The labour market

Unemployment is expected to be 4.8 per cent in 2027.

Risks to the outlook

The risks to the outlook are two-sided and broadly balanced.

Forward guidance

The Committee agreed that monetary policy will need to remain restrictive for some time. The Committee will continue to assess incoming data.
